coaching.headline: We won the majors 17 to 3 (river buffs, seedlings, and Fangtooth) and closed the game by 18 minutes off the decisive fight at 16.7.
coaching.team: Two of five lanes read favorably: carry and midlane. The duo lane (Murdock+Phase) also read 'ours' by game's end. Crunch lost the offlane to Greystone, and Aurora read even-then-losing against Zarus. Greystone drew first blood on Crunch at 6.2, then Zarus caught him alone again at 9.7, both before anyone on our side had built armor into a draft that finished four-fifths physical; by full time, none of us had, and Phase, Aurora and Crunch carry the no-armor flag outright. We still won the 11.7 teamfight 3-1, and an even 1-1 trade at 15.4 handed us the game's only tower. Lt. Belica, Crunch, Murdock and Phase combined for a 5-1 win at Fangtooth at 16.7 -- the fight that decided the game about a minute before the clock ran out. We finished the majors 17 to 3, but only one tower changed hands all game, and neither of our two won fights is credited with converting a structure beyond that trade.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 16.7 teamfight, won 5-1, decided it: Fangtooth fell in the same window, and the match ended about a minute later with no further kills recorded.
coaching.whatWorked: Our duo lane read ours by the end, with zero duo deaths before minute ten to the enemy's one, and claimed the game's first Fangtooth.

threats: Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

loadout.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Every third basic attack on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Murdock's basic-attack focus makes this a steady boost, best into tanks.

loadout.name: Serration
loadout.text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Adds missing-health damage on top of Vermis procs, helping finish hurt targets.

loadout.name: Melting Point
loadout.text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
loadout.plain: Extra damage only into enemies with over 125 physical armor. Buckshot's shred lowers their armor and can drop them below that line, so this is a pick into heavy tanks only.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.
loadout.plain: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on targets below 20% health. Dash in and finish a low target with a basic attack or Buckshot.

stacks.text: 3 effects on one trigger: Pacifier, Vermis, Melting Point. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (kept alive in fights), so every extra second in a fight made them harder to kill.

countered.text: 1 of the 3 players Murdock killed built physical armor (Steel).

copy.text: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 46.4% in 4,001 Murdock carry games, below the hero's 48.8%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

loadout.name: Psychic Support
loadout.text: Essence Catalyst also restores your Linked Ally's Mana by (+12% Target's Missing Mana) over the duration.
loadout.plain: Your passive also restores mana to your linked ally. Great for keeping a mana-hungry carry or mage casting through long fights.

loadout.name: Exarch
loadout.text: Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.
loadout.plain: Healing or shielding speeds up attacks and adds magic damage. Your passive heals you and your linked ally after every ability, so both of you keep the buff up.

loadout.name: Preservation
loadout.text: Healing or shielding you receive is increased by 10%.
loadout.plain: Heals and shields you receive are stronger. Your passive heals you after every cast, so this boosts your own sustain.

loadout.name: Fervour
loadout.text: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).
loadout.plain: Basic attacks on enemy heroes heal you and nearby allies. Pairs with Hyperflux attack speed: auto between abilities to heal your team.

loadout.name: Tranquility
loadout.text: Grace:  Heal yourself and nearby Heroes by 150 (+70%). Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s. Visionary:  Gain Solstone. Increase Ward Cap from 2 to 3. Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.
loadout.plain: Heals you and nearby allies and briefly reduces damage taken. Use it in a teamfight when the enemy burst lands; it also adds a ward.

lines: Lead story: Built to deal damage, not to soak it. 593 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Phase support players this patch (19% of the team's), while mitigating less than 83% of them. The damage came from Sky Splitter, Tranquility, Exarch. Died 0 times.
Hyperflux at rank 1: 125s base, about 108.7s by the end (13% shorter) from 15 ability haste: Marshal 15.
Phase dealt 10,681 hero damage, 19% of their team's, with +45 magical power from items.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Tranquility (crest): Heal yourself and nearby Heroes by 150 (+70%). Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s.
Exarch (Eternal): Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.

Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s.; Preservation: Healing or shielding you receive is increased by 10%.; Fervour: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).; 8,094 healing recorded.
Toughness: +100 health; took 10,595 damage, mitigated 4,633, died 0 times.

(game text: Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.) (game text: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).) [2 + 0.5 a level: 7.5 at level 11] Field: 50.3% in 4680 games, 92% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.4%.

Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.) Field: 50% in 5325 games, 71% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.4%.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Tranquility, Exarch, Preservation, Fervour.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Marshal, Sky Splitter, Exarch, Fervour.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 4 effects on one trigger: Tranquility, Exarch, Preservation, Fervour. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

The Eternal was part of it: Exarch (Preservation + Fervour) sits on the same triggers as the items (healing off the damage; every basic attack set off; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 0 of the 3 players Phase killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on TwinBlast. We killed Phase 0 times.
Copy it? Exarch (Preservation + Fervour): 49.9% in 3,570 Phase support games, level with the hero's 49.4%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
